final: WITH s AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS cnt FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.cnt AS feature_count, CAST(s.cnt AS REAL)/t.total AS share, CAST(s.cnt AS REAL)/t.total - 1.0/t.n AS margin_above_avg FROM s, t WHERE CAST(s.cnt AS REAL)/t.total > 1.0/t.n ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
